briefs.text: Raid kills 1, hits St Volodymyr's Cathedral.
Israel says raid past Yellow Line is over.
IRGC claims two supertankers hit mines.
Houthis: Saudi raids killed 10 in 2 days.
Reserve Bank holds at 7.25% on 4–3 vote.
R21 malaria jabs cut clinical cases 47%.
US group wins Mirma Hill rare-earths bid.
Raid kills at least 34 suspected gangsters.

features.headline: Crimean Bridge hit, third time in a week
features.summary: Trains halted. Putin: Russia “will not negotiate”.

features.headline: COP31 draft drops fossil-fuel language
features.summary: Revised text also loses the $120bn adaptation goal.

features.headline: Cyclone Akvan: 120,000 evacuated
features.summary: Due ashore near Gopalpur on Friday; schools shut.

features.headline: Saudis say Houthi missile shot down
features.summary: Sirens at 04:12; debris damaged a tower, no hurt.

features.headline: Somalia expels the UAE's ambassador
features.summary: Given 72 hours to leave; Somalia cites sovereignty.

features.headline: Denmark ratifies US Greenland pact
features.summary: Vote 109–0; new US sites at Narsarsuaq, Mestersvig.

features.headline: Korea's top court orders Han retrial
Lula ends Brazil's six-day work week
features.summary: Cap falls to 42 hours in December, to 40 by 2027.

features.headline: Anthropic closes up 17% on debut
features.summary: Priced at $83; it closed its first day at $97.17.

features.headline: Australia's jobless rate rises to 4.9%
features.summary: Highest since 2021; 43,500 jobs went in October.

kicker: Trump, Xi and Putin share one table  ·  The World Court finds genocide in Myanmar  ·  GTA VI goes on sale after 13 years

leads.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
leads.summary: A 90-minute meeting beside APEC. Their joint “Declaration Toward Peace” says a nuclear war “cannot be won”.

leads.headline: World Court: Myanmar committed genocide
leads.summary: The first ruling that a state committed genocide. Reparations ordered; the vote was 9–6.

leads.headline: GTA VI goes on sale, 13 years after GTA V
leads.summary: Launches rolled west from New Zealand at local midnight. Pre-orders topped an estimated 15.88 million units.

numbers.cap: leaders at one table: US, China, Russia
